    '2. AGREEMENT OVERVIEW

This Design Package Contract ("Agreement") is entered into between Design Your Price, LLC ("DYP"), a Utah limited liability company headquartered in Orem, Utah, and the Client identified above. This Agreement governs the provision of professional design services for the residential project described herein.

By signing this Agreement, the Client authorizes DYP to commence design work and acknowledges that the Design Package Fee is due in full upon execution of this Agreement. Payment of the Design Package Fee is a condition precedent to DYP initiating any design work.

3. DESIGN PACKAGE DELIVERABLES

The Design Package Fee covers the following professional services and deliverables:

  - Architectural & Floor Plan Drawings: Scaled floor plans reflecting existing conditions and proposed layout changes, including dimensions, room designations, and structural openings as applicable.

  - 3D Renderings: Computer-generated three-dimensional visualizations of the proposed design to assist the Client in understanding the scope and aesthetic of the project.

  - Material Selections & Design Board: A curated selections package including finishes, fixtures, and materials appropriate to the project scope, presented in a visual design board format.

  - Permit-Ready Drawing Set: Construction documents prepared to meet applicable Utah building department submittal requirements, suitable for permit application.

  - Structural Engineering Coordination: Coordination with a licensed structural engineer as needed for the proposed scope. Structural engineering fees, if assessed separately by the engineer of record, are addressed in Section 6.

Deliverables are scoped to the project described in Section 1. Material changes to project scope after design work commences may require a written change order and additional fees.

4. DESIGN PACKAGE FEE & PAYMENT TERMS

4.1 Design Package Fee Basis: The Design Package Fee is calculated exclusively on an hourly basis. Each design project is assigned a set number of allocated design hours as specified in the Design Proposal accepted by the Client.

4.2 Included Hours: The allocated hours cover all design work anticipated for the project scope, including design development, drawing production, material research and selections, coordination with structural engineering, and travel time.

4.3 Additional Hours: Additional hours beyond the allocated amount will be billed at $80.00 per hour. DYP will make reasonable efforts to notify the Client when approaching the allocated hour limit.

4.4 Payment of Base Fee: The Design Package Fee is due and payable in full upon Client execution of this Agreement. DYP will not commence any design work until payment has been received and confirmed.

4.5 Void for Non-Payment: If the base Design Package Fee is not received within five (5) business days of Agreement execution, DYP reserves the right to void this Agreement without further obligation.

5. NON-REFUNDABLE FEE POLICY

The Design Package Fee is strictly non-refundable under all circumstances, regardless of whether the Client proceeds to a construction contract with DYP. The Design Package Fee will NOT be credited toward any future construction contract. Design services are priced and delivered as a standalone professional service.

6. ADDITIONAL FEES & OUT-OF-SCOPE WORK

6.1 Structural Engineering: If the project requires a licensed structural engineer to produce stamped drawings, engineering fees will be billed separately and are not included in the Design Package Fee unless explicitly noted in a written addendum.

6.2 Change Orders: Any material changes to the project scope requested by the Client after design work has commenced will be addressed via a written Change Order.

6.3 Permit Fees: Municipal permit application fees, plan check fees, and any third-party agency fees are the sole responsibility of the Client.

6.4 Revisions: Revision work is tracked as design hours. Revisions that cause the project to exceed the allocated hour budget will be billed at $80.00 per hour.

7. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY & USE OF DELIVERABLES

7.1 All drawings, renderings, documents, and design work product produced by DYP under this Agreement are the intellectual property of DYP until the Design Package Fee has been paid in full.

7.2 Upon receipt of full payment, DYP grants the Client a limited, non-exclusive license to use the deliverables for the specific project identified in Section 1.

7.3 DYP retains the right to use photographs, renderings, and project images for portfolio, marketing, and promotional purposes, subject to reasonable Client privacy accommodations upon written request.

8. DESIGN TIMELINE

DYP will provide the Client with an estimated design timeline upon receipt of full payment. Timelines are estimates only and are subject to change based on project complexity, Client response times, municipal requirements, and engineering coordination.

Client agrees to respond to DYP requests for information, decisions, and approvals within five (5) business days. Delays caused by Client failure to respond in a timely manner may extend the design timeline without liability to DYP.

9. CLIENT REPRESENTATIONS

By executing this Agreement, the Client represents and warrants that:
  - Client has full legal authority to authorize design work at the project address.
  - All information provided to DYP is accurate and complete to the best of Client knowledge.
  - Client understands and accepts the non-refundable nature of the Design Package Fee.
  - Client has reviewed and agrees to all terms and conditions of this Agreement prior to signing.

10. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

DYP liability under this Agreement is limited to the amount of the Design Package Fee paid by the Client. DYP shall not be liable for indirect, consequential, incidental, punitive, or special damages of any kind.

11. GOVERNING LAW & DISPUTE RESOLUTION

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Utah. Any dispute shall first be subject to good-faith mediation. If mediation is unsuccessful, disputes shall be resolved by binding arbitration in Utah County, Utah, in accordance with the rules of the American Arbitration Association. The prevailing party shall be entitled to recover reasonable attorney fees and costs.

12. ENTIRE AGREEMENT

This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between DYP and the Client with respect to the design services described herein and supersedes all prior discussions, representations, and agreements, whether oral or written.',
